tool_schemas.name: generate_images
tool_schemas.description: Creates an image-generation job in the specified workspace for the gemini-imagen-3.0 model, persists the provided provider request payload, and—when execute=true—executes the job under the given API key and returns the created job record including status and any resulting image artifact metadata when available. If idempotency_key is provided, repeated requests with the same key return the previously created job instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ULIDs, unsupported model, or invalid payload shape; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the api_key_id is not valid for the workspace; QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the API key’s rate/usage limits are exceeded; and CONFLICT if the job cannot be executed due to an invalid state transition (e.g., attempting to execute a job that is already completed/failed).

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) that owns the generation job and resulting artifacts.

api_key_id.description: API key ULID (imgkey_...) used to execute and rate-limit the generation request.

model.description: Imagen model to use for the job.

request_payload.description: Raw provider request payload to persist on the job (prompt, params, safety, etc.).

execute.description: Whether to execute the job immediately (true) or only enqueue/persist it (false).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to deduplicate repeated job creation requests.

tool_schemas.name: create_image_html
tool_schemas.description: Generates an HTML gallery snippet (img tags / gallery view) referencing the provided image_paths for the given workspace, and returns the generated HTML; when persist=true it also stores the gallery and returns the persisted gallery record. This endpoint does not page results because it creates a single gallery from the provided list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is malformed, image_paths is empty, or inputs are otherwise invalid; NOT_FOUND when any referenced image path does not correspond to an image artifact in the workspace; FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create galleries in the workspace; and CONFLICT when persist=true and the gallery cannot be stored due to a conflicting existing resource or invalid state.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) that will own the stored HTML gallery.

title.description: Human-readable title for the HTML gallery.

image_paths.description: List of stored image file paths to include in the generated HTML gallery.

persist.description: Whether to persist the generated HTML as an html_galleries row.

tool_schemas.name: list_image_generation_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists image-generation jobs in a workspace, optionally filtered by status, time window, and API key. Returns a stable, paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses access if the workspace is deleted; may return RATE_LIMITED when authenticated API key quota is exhausted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) to list jobs for.

api_key_id.description: Optional API key ULID (imgkey_...) used to scope results and enforce access; revoked keys may read but cannot create/execute.

provider_request_id.description: Optional provider request id filter (exact match).

created_after.description: Optional lower bound (inclusive) for job created_at.

created_before.description: Optional upper bound (inclusive) for job created_at.

page_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_image_generation_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single image-generation job by id and returns the job record including any persisted response_payload and associated artifact metadata (when available). Refuses access if the job is not in the given workspace or the workspace is deleted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) that owns the job.

api_key_id.description: Optional API key ULID (imgkey_...) used to authorize the read when required by the workspace policy.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_image_generation_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running image-generation job. Transitions status to cancelled and persists finished_at; if partial artifacts exist they are marked deleted. Refuses cancellation when the job is already in a terminal state (succeeded|failed|cancelled), when the workspace is deleted, or when the API key is revoked.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) that owns the job.

job_id.description: Image generation job ULID (imgjob_...) to cancel.

api_key_id.description: API key ULID (imgkey_...) used to authorize the cancellation and enforce limits.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to persist with the job error_message.

tool_schemas.name: list_image_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored image artifacts in a workspace, optionally filtered by job and status. Returns a stable, paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses access if the workspace is deleted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) to list artifacts for.

job_id.description: Optional job ULID (imgjob_...) to filter artifacts to a single generation job.

file_path_prefix.description: Optional prefix match for artifact file_path (useful for folder-style grouping).

page_size.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: delete_image_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes an available image artifact by transitioning status from available to deleted and setting deleted_at. Refuses deletion if the artifact is already deleted, if the workspace is deleted, or if the artifact does not belong to the given workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (imgwsp_...) that owns the artifact.

api_key_id.description: Optional API key ULID (imgkey_...) used to authorize the write; revoked keys cannot delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and effective entitlements for the current credential, including workspace access (when scoped), granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses when no credential is provided or when the credential is invalid/revoked.

api_key_id.description: API key ULID (imgkey_...) to introspect; must match the credential presented to the service.
